text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Master, race observation operation 
complete. Arrived at the nearest station’ 
...Email sent."

text_block_list.name: Overseas Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! I'm a race reporter! A little 
photo, OK?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I have nothing planned after this. ...In 
other words, 'quick photos are OK.'"

text_block_list.name: Overseas Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Good! Photo, news, will use! Byeee, Mihono 
Bourbon♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I am Mihono Bourbon. In the English 
alphabet, it is written as Mihono Bourbon, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Platform Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The limited express has arrived! 
Departing immediately! Please step behind 
the yellow line!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Situation analysis. The reporter boarded 
the express train; correction failed. Risk 
of the world recognizing you by the wrong 
name is present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Confirmed no trains can overtake the 
limited express. However, my speed is 
superior. ...Commencing run."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Correction, complete. 
Fatigue from unexpected exercise... 
confirmed...

I managed to correct the reporter on how 
to pronounce my name, but the whole ordeal 
left me completely exhausted...
